nodes.title: Agentic identity — the non-human / agent identity opportunity
nodes.canonical: ~$60bn+ over the coming years, DOUBLE the standalone identity market; named winners PANW, OKTA, SAIL — CRWD NOT on the list (MS Marshall/Lountzis, 2026-08-20, via digest; underlying report not read in full).
